conditions: The Evangelism Committee (president, secretary, treasurer, evangelism director as adviser, four lay members, two pastors) reviews requests at six meetings a year.

Bible workers: approved by the Evangelism Committee before hiring; conference pays 70% of salary for up to six months (church 30%, invoiced by treasury); church board minutes must be sent to the conference.
Evangelistic materials (Bibles, books, children's resources, GLOW tracts) paid at 70%.
Food allowance up to $1,500 and decorations up to $500, each paid at 70%; anything above is the church's cost.
Buying equipment is the church's own cost; renting equipment for a specific event can be included in the request.
Car rental (and its fuel, not mileage) is reimbursable for a guest evangelist coming from outside the conference.

Pastor extras: $0.52 a mile over the district cap (up to 1,000 miles) for reaping events; equipment allowance $75 a night up to 28 nights ($2,100 a year, taxable) for preaching a conference-approved and funded series of at least a week in the pastor's own district, aimed at non-members.

For the pastor's equipment allowance the form asks for dates, number of meetings, average attendance, baptisms/POFs, remaining interests, the name and contact details of each person baptized (or the clerk's list) and a written follow-up and discipling plan. Bible workers report regularly to the pastor, church board and conference.

Some Arkansas and Louisiana churches belong to the Southwest Region Conference instead (same states, different conference). notes: Two evangelism departments: English (with its own site, TexasEvangelism.com) and Spanish (under the Vice President for Hispanic Ministries & Spanish Evangelism, page https://www.texasadventist.org/departments/evangelismo/). Current English funding rules sit behind a login. The removed "Financial Assistance" page (archived copy, describing 2020) gave each church an annual allotment of $1,000 to $9,000 by formula, requested by the district pastor by 31 October of the year before; treat this as history and confirm with the English Evangelism Department (evangelism@txsda.org). Files on files.texasadventist.org (guest speaker payments, Sterling guidelines) did not resolve when checked. Texas Conference camp meeting 13–15 Nov 2026 at Lake Whitney Ranch. Union level (Southwestern Union): an Evangelism Endowment Fund pays for evangelistic outreach, church growth and other soul-winning projects; the union president's office distributes it "in response to proposals submitted from the local conference", so a church asks through its conference, not the union. The union has also, each fall, returned unused union funds to the five conferences "for evangelism and special needs" (Record, 2019; amounts vary). The union Evangelism Department names two projects, Fanning the Flames of Evangelism (training) and Project 10 (grow membership 10%), and runs a yearly Field School of Evangelism with Southwestern Adventist University theology students in host churches (2026: Houston and Austin area).
